timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Is there a Gen Z trope or stereotype about teenagers that you see in scripts or on TV that gets under your skin?
I think for me, because I also, I look a bit younger, I've been acting for a little over a decade now,
so I've just been a teenager pretty much in stories.
And I feel like it's always the bratty teen, bad mouthed teen, or a lot of times unintelligent,
which I don't think is true.
And I think it's hard to nowadays with all this new lingo coming around, but I feel like my generation,
because there is so much accessible to them on the internet, there's just more opportunities for them to learn.
I wish that they were giving a bit more credit.

youtube_description:
Golden Globe-nominated actor Jenna Ortega is no stranger to a challenge, and she proves it in this interview with First We Feast. In this episode of Hot Ones, Ortega takes on the wings of death, a series of increasingly spicy chicken wings. But even as the heat builds, Ortega never flinches. She keeps her cool and answers questions about her career, her love of horror movies, and her secret to making the perfect guacamole.

Watch Jenna Ortega face her fears and see if she can make it to the last wing.
